name: Microsoft 365
conditions: Plain text name only to describe compatibility
paraphrase: Logos, product icons and designs generally need an express licence; names may truthfully describe compatibility without implying endorsement; icons not allowed as app icons.
notes: Text wordmark safer.

name: Google One / Google AI plans
paraphrase: Google must approve a request before its logos/brand features are used; approval is per-request and revocable; fuller guidance only for co-branding partners.
notes: Referential/text use not addressed on page read.

name: iCloud+
paraphrase: Apple logos/graphic symbols need an express written licence; word marks may be used referentially (e.g. 'compatible with') if less prominent than own name and no endorsement implied.
notes: iCloud-specific logo rule not found; text name is the safe option.

name: Dropbox
conditions: Consider emailing Dropbox for commercial confirmation
paraphrase: Check with Dropbox before commercial use; may say product works with Dropbox and link with logo per guidelines; no editing/recolouring or implied affiliation.
notes: Page asks to check before commercial use; no approval obtained. Text alternative is safer.

name: Notion
conditions: Use only official brand elements, unmodified
paraphrase: Per search snippets of Notion's guidelines: descriptive reference to how a product relates to Notion is allowed; only listed brand elements permitted; permission revocable; attribution required.
notes: Official page not directly readable (fetch returned no text); relies on search summary. Verify.

name: Slack
conditions: Send mockup to Slack for uses outside guidelines
paraphrase: Third parties may use Slack logos/assets without separate agreement if they follow the brand guidelines; uses outside guidelines need written approval; revocable.
notes: Closest to GREEN, but detailed guideline rules (e.g. non-integration use) not read; kept YELLOW.

name: Zoom
paraphrase: Per search summaries: stylised marks/icons/logos need written licence or express permission (brand@zoom.us); word marks may be used descriptively.
notes: Official page fetch failed/returned empty; based on search results. Verify before relying.

name: Adobe Creative Cloud
conditions: Plain text name with attribution if used
paraphrase: Adobe allows trademarks (not logos) to identify products; logos generally need licence or written authorisation via form.

name: Canva Pro
paraphrase: Logo downloadable only for approved integration uses (entry point / Powered by Canva); not for unrelated uses; no alteration; text 'works with' allowed.
notes: Rules are for Canva integrations; our use is not one.

name: Grammarly
paraphrase: No official guideline text retrieved (press page redirects to superhuman.com/press, not read).
notes: Unknown; treat cautiously.

name: Figma
paraphrase: Third parties may use Figma marks to identify Figma or its products if truthful and not misleading; may use name/logos to link to Figma; no modification; revocable.
notes: Guidance aimed at integrations/informational content; broadly covers identification.

name: Evernote
conditions: Credit Bending Spoons US Inc. as owner, 'used under license'
Unaltered logo, own branding more prominent
paraphrase: Logo/app icon may link to service or show compatibility, subject to a trademark licence (attribution, quality, indemnity, auto-termination); no altering or confusing use.
notes: Use binds to licence terms with indemnity; consider text.

name: 1Password
paraphrase: Press page says media kit contains logos and brand guidelines; no usage terms visible.
notes: Media-kit terms not read.

name: Bitwarden Premium
paraphrase: Brand page covers only Bitwarden's own usage; trademark policy says third-party use of marks needs written agreement/permission (aimed at forks/branding).

name: NordVPN
paraphrase: Explicit written consent needed for Nord marks/logos; narrow exception for word marks to truthfully identify; no recolouring or modification.

name: ExpressVPN
paraphrase: Could not reach official press/brand page (connection reset); nothing confirmed.
notes: Unknown.

name: Surfshark
paraphrase: Assets licensed for personal/non-commercial use only; commercial use requires written permission (media@surfshark.com).
notes: From search summary of official page.

name: Proton (VPN/Mail/Drive)
paraphrase: No logo-usage page found; fetch timed out.
notes: Unknown.

name: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
conditions: No OpenAI marks in app name
paraphrase: OpenAI publishes a third-party brand guide (prominence, clear space, revocable permission, naming limits); fetch blocked (403) so specifics from search summary.

name: Claude (Anthropic)
paraphrase: Third parties may use Anthropic logos only with prior written approval for specific uses; no alteration; no implied endorsement; plain-text referential use not addressed.

name: Google AI Pro (Gemini)
paraphrase: Google brand features require approval via request form; revocable.
notes: No Gemini-specific rule found.

name: Perplexity Pro
paraphrase: No official brand guideline located.
notes: Unknown; Perplexity is itself a litigant in trademark cases, no evidence of tracker enforcement.

name: Cursor
paraphrase: Brand page offers an asset package and naming guidance but no stated third-party logo terms.

name: GitHub Copilot
conditions: If a mark is used, GitHub Invertocat unmodified and less prominent than Buddget
paraphrase: GitHub permits logos to show integration, forbids recolouring or use as own icon, and requires written permission for other uses; Copilot has no standalone logo since 2025.
notes: Use initials/text for Copilot.

name: Midjourney
paraphrase: Trademark policy (Aug 2023, via search summary) requires exact reproduction and a non-endorsement disclaimer; no use in business/product names.
notes: Direct fetch 403.

name: AWS
paraphrase: Fair use limited to plain text with no logos; any other logo use needs prior written permission.

name: GoDaddy
paraphrase: Logos protected; permission requests (permissions@godaddy.com) evaluated case by case; many refused as implying endorsement.
notes: Via search summary; direct fetch 403.

name: Namecheap
paraphrase: No official brand guideline found.
notes: Unknown.

name: Cloudflare
conditions: Plain text word mark as adjective only
paraphrase: Logos off-limits without written permission; word marks usable to refer to services.

name: DigitalOcean
paraphrase: Logos/designs need prior approval; referential use allowed in plain text; no stylising; forum staff reply says no logos on third-party apps without agreement.
